variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
variables.boundary: Development permits active runtime behavior; Production is unconditional dark containment.

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_MODE
variables.format: active in Development; dark in Production
variables.boundary: Production requires only DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT, DEPLOYMENT_MODE, and SOURCE_REVISION and rejects every invocation before SDK or store access.

variables.name: X_ZOHO_CATALYST_ENVIRONMENT
variables.boundary: Worker rejects missing, Production, or mismatched platform identity before SDK initialization.

variables.name: ZOHO_CATALYST_ZCQL_PARSER
variables.boundary: Required for bounded conditional updates.

variables.name: SOURCE_REVISION
variables.boundary: Must exactly match the immutable revision embedded by the isolated release-artifact builder.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_RUNTIME_HOST
variables.format: exact private Catalyst Advanced I/O host
variables.boundary: Must match the configured environment and request Host; value stays outside Git.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_PROJECT_ID
variables.format: exact private numeric Catalyst project ID
variables.boundary: Must match the immutable SDK/Job project identity; value stays outside Git.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_WORKER_JOB_POOL_ID
variables.format: exact private numeric Development Function Job pool ID
variables.boundary: Worker validates it before SDK, Data Store, or Mail access.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_ORCHESTRATOR_HOST
variables.format: exact private Development Catalyst Advanced I/O host
variables.boundary: Must exactly match CRM_BILLING_ORCHESTRATOR_URL; Production remains dark and does not load it.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_ORCHESTRATOR_URL
variables.format: exact HTTPS Development Catalyst route with no query, fragment, credentials, or non-default port
variables.boundary: Sole bounded route for sync_report_summary; the value and private path stay outside Git.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_API_GATEWAY_KEY
variables.format: 16-4096 non-whitespace characters sent only as ZCFKEY
variables.boundary: Platform-generated Development Catalyst API Gateway key, which may be common across Development projects and is never sole authorization. Regenerate/replace it only when the Catalyst control plane exposes that operation and old-key rejection can be proven; otherwise record it non-rotatable and rotate the independent report-only second factor. Production uses a separately generated key.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_SHARED_HEADER_NAME
variables.boundary: Must equal the orchestrator SHARED_HEADER_NAME; it is not ZCFKEY or x-api-key.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_SHARED_HEADER_VALUE
variables.boundary: Report-only caller credential paired with orchestrator REPORT_SUMMARY_HEADER_VALUE; it cannot authorize paid or reconcile actions.

variables.name: CRM_BILLING_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.boundary: End-to-end timeout includes response headers and a maximum 4096-byte JSON body.

variables.name: RETELL_WEBHOOK_API_KEY
variables.boundary: Retell signature verification only.

variables.name: RETELL_SHARED_AGENT_ID
variables.boundary: Exact shared free-test monitor binding; paid capability profiles remain disabled.

variables.name: RETELL_SHARED_AGENT_VERSION
variables.boundary: Exact shared monitor version.

variables.name: RETELL_INBOUND_PATH
variables.boundary: No alternate ingress route.

variables.name: RETELL_EVENTS_PATH
variables.boundary: Authenticated durable event ingress.

variables.name: RETELL_SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE_MS
variables.boundary: Five-minute signature window.

variables.name: MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES
variables.boundary: Raw request limit before JSON parse.

variables.name: INBOUND_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.boundary: Bounded raw-body read.

variables.name: EVENT_HMAC_SECRET
variables.boundary: Durable keys, fingerprints, and ownership tokens.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_PARTITION_HMAC_SECRET
variables.boundary: Dedicated shared key for stable opaque Analytics client/deployment partitions across approved producers; distinct from runtime event identity.

variables.name: NUMBER_LOOKUP_HMAC_SECRET
variables.boundary: Non-reversible called-number lookup only.

variables.name: INTERNAL_READINESS_TOKEN
variables.boundary: Authenticates GET /internal/readiness.

variables.name: INTERNAL_READINESS_PATH
variables.boundary: Development-only private readiness route. Production dark mode returns 503 on every path.

variables.name: DEPLOYMENT_TABLE
variables.boundary: Canonical route deployment state.

variables.name: CONFIGURATION_VERSION_TABLE
variables.boundary: Authoritative immutable configuration versions.

variables.name: EVENT_RECEIPT_TABLE
variables.boundary: Durable event claim, dispatch, lease, and replay state.

variables.name: CANONICAL_CALL_TABLE
variables.boundary: Canonical tenant-bound call outcomes.

variables.name: NOTIFICATION_TABLE
variables.boundary: Durable dry-run or bounded Development email state.

variables.name: ANALYTICS_OUTBOX_TABLE
variables.boundary: Sanitized additive-v2 delivery infrastructure; never reverse-writes runtime authority.

variables.name: OPERATION_TABLE
variables.boundary: Producer-only terminal report-summary handoff. crm_billing_orchestrator owns consumption and CRM write/readback.

variables.name: PLATFORM_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.boundary: Bounded Catalyst calls including Function Job submission.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_NOTIFICATION_MODE
variables.boundary: Production accepts dry_run only; committed default is dry_run.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_MAIL_FROM
variables.boundary: Private environment-specific sender; no committed value.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_MAIL_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.boundary: Provider invocation ceiling.

variables.name: REVENUE_DESK_NOTIFICATION_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.boundary: Bounded retry state machine.

variables.name: EXPECTED_CATALYST_PROJECT_ID_SHA256
variables.format: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact private Development project ID
variables.boundary: Binds the request and SDK runtime to one project without committing its identifier.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_HOST
variables.format: exact private Development Catalyst Advanced I/O host
variables.boundary: Must match the request Host and a Development Catalyst domain; value stays outside Git.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_SHARED_HEADER_NAME
variables.format: exact private x-* header name excluding x-zcfkey and x-api-key
variables.boundary: Independent second factor injected only by the Administrator-restricted CRM Connection.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_SHARED_HEADER_VALUE
variables.boundary: Compared before body or SDK access and distinct from every HMAC key.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_OPERATOR_IDENTITY
variables.format: private authenticated operator or Connection identity
variables.boundary: Only its domain-separated keyed digest enters the audit receipt.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_OPERATOR_HMAC_SECRET
variables.boundary: Signs server-minted approval and activation intents; never accepted from the browser.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_EVENT_HMAC_SECRET
variables.boundary: Creates immutable idempotency and chained authorization-event identities.

variables.name: ROUTE_CONTROL_MAX_BODY_BYTES
variables.boundary: Bounds the authenticated JSON command before parsing.

variables.name: CRM_ORGANIZATION_ID
variables.format: exact private numeric CRM organization ID
variables.boundary: Binds the hashed operator identity and approved CRM Connection to one organization.

variables.name: CRM_API_BASE_URL
variables.format: exact regional Zoho CRM v8 API root
variables.boundary: No alternate host, query, fragment, credentials, or non-default port.

variables.name: CRM_READ_CONNECTION_LINK_NAME
variables.boundary: Connection must return only one Zoho OAuth Authorization header.

variables.name: CRM_WRITE_CONNECTION_LINK_NAME
variables.boundary: Used only after fresh precondition reads for bounded Deal and Blueprint mutations.

variables.name: RETELL_API_BASE_URL
variables.boundary: No alternate provider host or path prefix.

variables.name: RETELL_ROUTE_MODE
variables.boundary: Disabled permits non-telephony approval and containment while activation fails closed with ISOLATED_RETELL_TEST_NUMBER_REQUIRED.

variables.name: RETELL_CONNECTION_LINK_NAME
variables.boundary: Connection must return only one Retell Bearer Authorization header.

variables.name: RETELL_TEST_PHONE_NUMBER
variables.format: one isolated E.164 Development test number
variables.boundary: Never committed, purchased, inferred, or used until live readback proves isolation.

variables.name: RETELL_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.format: exact private Development inbound resolver URL
variables.boundary: Must match the authoritative Retell number readback.

variables.name: RETELL_ROLLBACK_INSTRUCTIONS
variables.boundary: Returned to the authenticated operator only when automatic provider restoration cannot be proven.

secret_rules: Real secrets, private IDs, hosts, sender addresses, customer data, and provider identifiers stay in Catalyst private configuration.
Webhook, event-HMAC, Analytics-partition, number-lookup, readiness, API Gateway, and report-caller secrets must be distinct.
Logs contain only safe event names, modes, public correlation IDs, bounded states, and error codes.
production_rules: Production configuration contains only DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=production, DEPLOYMENT_MODE=dark, and the release-stamped SOURCE_REVISION.
Every Production gateway path and worker invocation fails with 503 before SDK initialization or durable access.
No repository change, dark deployment, table provisioning, or draft paid profile authorizes activation.
